question: In which Indian musician’s name did the state of Massachusetts in the USA declare April 20th in 1984 as a day in his name?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amjad Ali Khan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amjad Ali Khan** is the renowned Indian musician in whose honor the state of Massachusetts declared April 20th, 1984 as a day in his name.
 
• He is a celebrated **sarod player** known for his contributions to Indian classical music.
 
• The recognition by the state of Massachusetts reflects his international acclaim and the global appreciation of his musical talent.
 
• Amjad Ali Khan has received numerous awards and honors, including the **Padma Vibhushan**, India's second-highest civilian award.
 
• His music has been a significant cultural bridge between India and the world, promoting Indian classical music on a global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amjad Ali Khan** was born on October 9, 1945, in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, India.
 
• He belongs to a family of musicians and is a sixth-generation sarod player.
 
• His style of playing is known for its purity of sound and emotional depth.
 
• He has performed at numerous prestigious venues worldwide, including Carnegie Hall, Royal Albert Hall, and the Sydney Opera House.
 
• In addition to his performances, Amjad Ali Khan has composed several ragas and has written books on Indian classical music.
